rare_drug_caveat: CAP/ETH/LZD have extremely low positive support: train n=21/4/2, val n=5/1/1, test n=4/0/2. ETH has ZERO test positives -- its test F1 is trivially defined and its ROC-AUC/PR-AUC are undefined (see per-seed auc_note). CAP and LZD test support (4 and 2) is also too small for their F1 to be a statistically reliable model-quality signal, in either direction. Do not treat high F1 on these three drugs as evidence of reliable performance.
